page_title: MAR 2-0 REN | Marseille v Rennes 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
90+5' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+5' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+4' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Warmed Omari (Rennes) and blew his whistle.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Amine Gouiri (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amine Harit walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Veretout (Marseille).
82' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
81' What was Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' Julien Stephan decides to make a substitution. Martin Terrier will be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
79' Here is a change. Enzo Le Fee is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
79' Substitution. Benjamin Bourigeaud makes his way off the pitch and Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) comes on as his replacement.
79' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Marseille due to an offside in the build-up play.
79' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Marseille players aren’t happy.
78' Amine Harit (Marseille) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low shot that goes into the middle of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Renan Lodi leaves the pitch and Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) comes on.
76' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) attempts to discuss the decision with Willy Delajod, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
75' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
73' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
73' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Rennes win a corner kick.

72' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rennes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
70' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to substitute Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and he is replaced by Vitinha (Marseille).
70' Substitution. Ismaila Sarr will be replaced by Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille).
68' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and the referee sends him off!
67' A player from Rennes commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

65' 2 - 0 Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Steve Mandanda is just a bystander as the ball flies under the crossbar. The score is 2:0.
61' The game is interrupted now, Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
61' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) clatters into his opponent and is shown a red card by the referee! Despite protesting, he knows the match has ended for him.
59' Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul after Amine Gouiri (Rennes) hacks down one of his opponents.
58' Substitution. Baptiste Santamaria makes way for Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes).
58' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
57' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' A pass by Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
46' Half-time substitution. Gennaro Gattuso decided to make a change. Jonathan Clauss is replaced by Michael Murillo (Marseille).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Referee Willy Delajod sees the trip by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
40' Arthur Theate (Rennes) is being substituted because of an injury. Julien Stephan sends Warmed Omari on the pitch.
36' Yellow card. Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
34' The corner by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

34' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
28' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
27' Martin Terrier (Rennes) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
22' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Wonderful pass from Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) for Amine Harit, but they can't profit from it as Steve Mandanda comes off his line to collect.
20' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
19' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
19' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
18' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
16' Martin Terrier (Rennes) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
14' Steve Mandanda steps in and intercepts a long pass from Amine Harit (Marseille).
14' Handball! A player from Marseille handled the ball.
13' A pass by Adrien Truffert (Rennes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

10' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Martin Terrier (Rennes), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Steve Mandanda into the bottom left corner.
8' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
7' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) makes a slide tackle, but referee Willy Delajod blows for a foul. PENALTY to Marseille! Great chance to score.
4' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Marseille will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Willy Delajod.
